name: Intern-S2-397B

lineage.how_derived: the card does not name a base model; config.json uses the Qwen3.5 MoE architecture (model_type qwen3_5_moe, hybrid linear and full attention, 512 experts). Earlier members of the family: Intern-S2-Preview-397B (2026-07-16) and the 35B Intern-S2-Preview (2026-05-15) and Intern-S2-Mobius (2026-07-29).

purpose: The card calls it the lab's most capable multimodal foundation model for scientific intelligence and long-horizon agents: it scales pre-training (learning directly from raw pages of scientific literature), multi-task RL across 20+ scientific domains, and agent RL in sandboxed environments.

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: LICENSE read: the standard Apache License 2.0 text (11.5 KB); card tag apache-2.0.

architecture.kind: hybrid Gated DeltaNet + gated attention MoE with vision tower (Qwen3.5 MoE architecture, model_type qwen3_5_moe)
architecture.attention: full attention every 4th layer (full_attention_interval 4), 32 Q / 2 KV heads, head dim 256, hidden 4096
architecture.why_this_design: Not given by the card. The active-parameter count is not on the card.

pc-12gb.notes: smallest GGUF 91.6 GB (IQ1_S) against about 60 GB (9.6 VRAM + 50 RAM)

pc-16gb.notes: 91.6 GB against about 64 GB (13.6 VRAM + 50 RAM)

pc-24gb.variant: bartowski IQ1_S 91.6 GB or IQ1_M 101.8 GB
pc-24gb.notes: 21.6 GB VRAM + about 82 GB RAM = 104 GB: IQ1_S leaves 12 GB, IQ1_M only 2 GB; 1-bit quality of this model is unmeasured

pc-32gb.variant: bartowski IQ2_XXS 118.8 GB to Q2_K 154.5 GB
pc-32gb.notes: 29.6 GB VRAM + 128 GB RAM = about 158 GB: IQ2_XXS leaves about 39 GB for KV and the OS, Q2_K only about 3 GB; 2-bit quality unmeasured

mac-64gb+.notes: 91.6 GB against about 52 GB GPU share on a 64 GB Mac; Macs with 128 GB or more not assessed

engine_support.notes: Qwen3.5 MoE architecture with GGUFs and an mmproj available; the Qwen3.5 MoE family is the one Tona already runs (qwen35moe), but this checkpoint has not been tried.

strengths: Vendor: leading general reasoning among open models plus specialised scientific tasks such as biomolecular interaction design and material structure generation (card text; score table is an image)
weaknesses: No coding or agent-coding score read
soft.behavior: Recommended sampling top_p 0.95, top_k 50, min_p 0, temperature 0.8; text reasoning evaluated with up to 256K tokens inference length (card).
best_for: scientific multimodal work on 128 GB RAM machines
soft.maturity: Intern-S line from Shanghai AI Laboratory with several releases in six months (Preview, Mobius, 397B).

tona_fit.reason: Apache-2.0 verified, Qwen3.5 MoE architecture (supported by llama.cpp, close to what Tona runs) and 2-bit GGUFs that fit the 32 GB VRAM + 128 GB RAM class; but it is tuned for science, the card gives no numbers we could read, and no coding score exists. Its smaller siblings Intern-S2-Preview (35B, 73 GB BF16, qwen3_5_moe_text configuration, hidden 2048) and Intern-S2-Mobius (35B) fit the small classes and would be the first to evaluate.
